fusions.name: Shattering Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a coral-tipped arrow that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, then shatters, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Broken-Off Tip
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The coral tip snaps off in the wound, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rooted Marksman
fusions.desc: Grows a coral marksman that stands for 18 seconds and shoots an enemy within 7 tiles for 6 damage every 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Living Stave
fusions.desc: Conjures a bow of living coral. It increases your weapon damage by 10%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
